open_loop_offered_rate.criterion: Actual first call starts >=95% of frozen target; HTTPX waits still included
open_loop_offered_rate.scope: Client call-start rate only, not a claim of network wire rate or sustained capacity

recovery_scope: Same original commands only; a recovery PASS does not promote first-attempt capacity.

environment.load_client_location: separate spawned API process(es), real loopback TCP; shared host

data.scale: bounded synthetic small world; not 100k-event medium design

retry_policy.deadline_scope: No new retry starts after budget; in-flight attempt may finish later within HTTP timeout

mixed_read_distribution.history: one additional FACT timeline per task

load.hot_fraction_meaning: Fraction of read subjects mapped to one shared item; shared writer candidates remain agents/10 in every profile
load.cache_boundary: per-process query-result cache cold/warm; PostgreSQL and OS caches are not flushed
load.shared_conflict_policy: one predetermined TEST_FIXTURE control command before stale deliveries; not resource arbitration by database arrival order

metrics.outstanding_definition: Includes HTTPX connection-pool wait; server ingress is measured separately
metrics.client_pool_wait_timing_note: HTTPcore wait_for_connection await wall time includes event-loop scheduling; not pure server or pool queue time.
metrics.latency_warning: P99 for individual write categories has few samples; descriptive only

database_application.peak_connections_note: Conservative sum of per-process peaks; not a simultaneous sample

per_process.transaction_timing_note: SQLAlchemy begin to before commit/rollback; end callbacks are not successful commit counts, and timing excludes final server commit wait
per_process.pool_status_at_end: Pool size: 8  Connections in pool: 8 Current Overflow: 0 Current Checked out connections: 0

database_observer.stats_note: pg_stat_database cumulative counters may lag; application SQL and pool counters are separately measured by SQLAlchemy listeners

service_diagnostics.scheduler_note: Sum over currently live Linux threads; exiting threads can make cumulative samples decrease. Not a complete process-wide wait counter.
service_diagnostics.timing_note: Inclusive stages overlap. CPU is measured on the executing thread; connection acquisition includes pool wait, pre-ping and connect.

admission.peak_note: Sum of process peaks; see process snapshots for exact values

authentication_admission.peak_note: Sum of process peaks; see process snapshots for exact values

ingress.peak_note: Sum of process peaks; see process snapshots for exact values

external_model.note: No real or fixture model dispatch; this measures service behavior, not model concurrency

limitations: 1 API process(es) with eight aggregate pooled DB connections
Host is shared with other development tasks; wall-clock observations are not exclusive-host SLA
No sustained capacity or multi-hour soak claim
HTTP pipeline represents control commands; joint scheduler arbitration is validated separately
